A '''leather pants''' is the [[Leather armor|leather]] [[Armor#Leggings|leggings]], crafted from [[Tattered Leather|tattered leather]]. It gives 2 armor and has 200 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/leather_pants.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which gives the item the stats listed below.

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/leather/leggings</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===

Worn, it gives 2 armor. The vanilla item gives 2 armor with 75 durability.

It adds 1 block of safe fall distance.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Sturdy Leather|sturdy leather]]. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
